title: useLocalStorage Hook
description: A custom hook for syncing state with localStorage.
explanation_md: This hook provides a simple interface to persist state in the browser's local storage, handling serialization and deserialization automatically.

title: usePrevious Hook
description: Tracks the previous value of a prop or state.
explanation_md: Uses `useRef` to store the value from the previous render. The `useEffect` updates the ref after the render is committed.

title: Render Props Pattern
description: A component that shares state via a function prop.
explanation_md: Render props is a technique for sharing code between React components using a prop whose value is a function.

title: Basic Counter Component
description: A simple functional component with state management.
explanation_md: Demonstrates the most basic use of the `useState` hook to manage a numerical counter in a functional component.

title: ErrorBoundary Component
description: Catches JavaScript errors in child component trees.
explanation_md: Error boundaries are class components that catch errors anywhere in their child component tree, log those errors, and display a fallback UI.
